reviews.title: New filtering options
reviews.text:
The new update has made filtering options literally impossible to find clothes. So for example, if I want to see what is new in, I click on ‘new in’ and then I have the option to filter things that I want to see like trousers and tops.

The problem here is that you’ve given items impossible to second-guess names.

So if I want to filter by trousers, because that’s all I’m looking for, I have to tick ALL the boxes that have the word trousers. ‘Pull on’ trousers ‘jazz pants’ are some of the options. It is such a silly way to filter to items can we just make it nice and easy like it used to be? 

Ever since the new app has changed the way you filter, I can’t find items which means I don’t buy as much as I used to, I don’t realise half the items exist because I can’t find them.

reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text: It’s keeps logging me out of my account and losing my info and it’s getting really annoying

I really miss the previous H&M app.

The new design makes shopping much harder instead of easier. It’s now difficult to find specific items, categories, or filters, and browsing feels confusing. I spend much more time looking for products and often end up giving up instead of buying something.

The previous version was simple, intuitive, and focused on shopping. The new interface feels like it’s prioritizing visual design over usability.

I’m clearly not the only one who feels this way—many users have shared similar feedback since the redesign. Instead of encouraging shopping, the new experience is actually discouraging purchases.

As a loyal customer, I honestly find myself buying less because of the new app. Please consider bringing back the simpler navigation and making it easier to browse and find products.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text:
This is an absolute scam and customer should be extremely careful when using H&M.
The price displayed on product pages are not the prices charged in the cart. For example, a kids dress was listed for $6 on the product page but became $8 in the cart. 
What makes this even worse is that customer support is fully aware of the issue. Instead of fixing the problem, they simply suggest placing the order and contacting them afterward to receive a refund for the difference. In other words, they have no intention of correcting a pricing error that directly affects customers at checkout.
Displaying one price and charging another is unacceptable and feels deceptive. Customers should carefully verify every price in their cart before completing a purchase.
